title: Bidirectional requirement-evidence trace and post-hoc artifact quarantine
hypothesis: A bidirectional requirement-to-evidence contract can reject both unsupported preregistered requirements and evidence artifacts that have no preregistered acceptance role, preventing post-hoc artifact volume from being mistaken for support.
null_or_failure: A requirement has no evidence edge, an artifact has no preregistered requirement edge, a later artifact silently changes an acceptance gate, circular evidence satisfies itself, a source pointer is treated as execution evidence, or trace completeness becomes scientific proof.
test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate missing forward edges, missing reverse edges, circular edges, wrong proposal ownership, post-freeze acceptance text, evidence-class labels, and source-only pointers; require every unsupported or orphaned case to fail closed.
rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the orphan artifact, restore the frozen requirement wording, retain the failed vector, add only a separately reviewed trace edge, and keep the underlying claim at its prior bounded status.
boundary: Trace coverage is local provenance control, not scientific proof or external validation.
